tagline: Attach Drive files to Notion pages and organize folders by project
metaTitle: Google Drive Notion Integration: Embed Files in Project Docs
metaDescription: Embed Drive file previews in Notion project pages and create Drive folders for new projects. GAIA keeps document status in sync. See the setup steps.
intro:
Google Drive and Notion serve complementary purposes: one stores raw files while the other structures knowledge and projects. But teams often maintain two separate places that don't reference each other, forcing colleagues to hunt through folders for the file mentioned in a project page or vice versa.

GAIA links the two so files and documentation stay connected. Documents can be embedded in Notion pages automatically when projects start, and new project pages trigger the creation of organized Drive folder structures. Your files and your documentation always know about each other.

useCases.title: Embed Drive files in project pages
useCases.description: When a new document is added to a project folder, GAIA attaches it to the corresponding project page. Team members find all relevant files without leaving Notion.

useCases.title: Auto-create folders from Notion projects
useCases.description: When a new project page is created, GAIA creates a structured folder hierarchy for that project in Drive. File organization mirrors your project structure from day one.

useCases.title: Sync document status between Drive and Notion
useCases.description: When a document is moved to a 'Final' folder, GAIA updates the linked page status to 'Completed.' Document and project status stay consistent automatically.

useCases.title: Aggregate files into project dashboards
useCases.description: GAIA scans folders and populates a database with file names, owners, and links. Teams get a searchable index of all project documents inside the workspace.

howItWorks.step: Connect Google Drive and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Google Drive and Notion workspace. GAIA maps your folder structure to your database schema.
Define how projects correspond to folders and which file types to surface on the pages. GAIA uses these mappings to keep both sides aligned.
New files, folder changes, and document status updates are passed between the folders and the pages according to your rules. Both sides reflect the same project reality.

faqs.question: Can GAIA embed a Drive file preview inside a Notion page?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA embeds files as embed blocks so collaborators can preview documents directly within the page without downloading.

faqs.question: Does GAIA create sub-folders or just top-level folders?
faqs.answer: GAIA can create multi-level folder hierarchies based on templates you define. For example, each project gets Assets, Deliverables, and Archive sub-folders automatically.

faqs.question: What happens if a file is deleted?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect file deletions and update the linked page to mark the attachment as unavailable, keeping the documentation accurate.
